agentUtterance.text: I'm sorry to hear that. That can definitely be frustrating, especially if it's used to receive one-time verification codes. The next time you login to MyBell, you'll have the option to receive your verification code by email instead of your phone. That way, you can still securely log in. To learn more about MFA, you can visit bell.ca/mybellmfa. Have you tried using a tracking feature like "Find my iPhone" or "Find my Device"?

agentUtterance.text: Understood. I would suggest temporarily suspending your service to prevent unauthorized use. I will send a text to the device you're calling from, with a link to do it yourself. Is that alright?
